propositions: rebar must support s3://bucket/prefix as sync.remote to store encrypted ticket data in customer-owned S3 buckets instead of GitHub while preserving git/event data format and auto-commit/push flow

concurrent/legacy pushes can corrupt the S3 bucket by creating multiple bundle files for one ref, causing fresh clones to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed' and the store becomes unclonable
rebar must fail closed when sync.remote is s3:// but the git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below the minimum required version, with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install command
the multiple-bundles corruption state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent bundle heads into a single ref, preserving all commits and events from every head with no data loss
